title: I made a 90's mall melee game
author: GTTGgames
selftext:
I made a multiplayer mall melee game. (that's a lot of M's). It's a bit janky but also I kinda like that about it. Day 2 patch incoming. [https://glitchthroughtheground.itch.io/floorwalker](https://glitchthroughtheground.itch.io/floorwalker)  
  
Did a lot of server stuff for this one with [fly.io](http://fly.io) and lived in that powershell for a bit! Will update it tomorrow with a day 2 patch, but a lot of multiplayer learning with this one. Worked with Opus and Fable but leaned on Fable more - and created similar random seed levels similar to my other game Weird Town. The learnings and the style crossover has been wild - to see all the games kinda build on each other.

And yes Fable made that teaser ha - I edit and will make one too, but was cool to see it's take on a teaser.
